# Vocabulary scenarios/v0

Renderer fixture scenarios (`projections.scenarios` documents) as data: each scenario with the renderer that draws it and its synthetic extraction, or before, after and their comparison. Defined in docs/models/scenarios-model.md. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/scenarios/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/scenarios/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/scenarios/v0.json).

An extraction follows this vocabulary when its `vocabularies` include it; its `schema` must be `graph/v0`. The extraction schema applies this one to it.

## Typed data

The engine checks every typed field, and reports a violation at its path. Other `data` fields are open JSON.
